name: mq_unlink
description: mq_unlink removes the specified message queue name immediately. The queue itself is destroyed once any other processes that have the queue open close their descriptors referring to the queue.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the message queue to remove.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno

errors.description: The caller does not have permission to unlink this message queue.
There is no message queue with the given name.
